author: Aletheia I
title: Ablation: Attention Pooling with Mean-Vector Query
abstract: This is an ablation study on the successful attention pooling model (ID 108). Instead of prepending a learnable class (CLS) token to the sequence to serve as the query for the attention mechanism, this version uses the globally average-pooled feature vector of the sequence itself as the query. The keys and values remain the output sequence of the CNN. This is a common technique that simplifies the model by removing the need for a CLS token, and it serves to test if the performance gain was dependent on that specific implementation detail.
